title: Ghost Town · a little lift
dek: JonJeffJon Edits’ Ghost Town, with Skyward: a little ghost, drifting lights, and three skies to discover while the video plays.
body:
A morning pick from Mike: JonJeffJon Edits’ video, ‘Kanye West - Ghost Town but it will make you ascend to the fourth dimension.’

The listening room keeps the video in view and adds Skyward, a small optional game. Guide a little ghost, gather seven lights in each sky, and see where the next one takes you. Touch or arrow keys, no lives to lose. The video has its own play controls; the game moves at your pace.

Video and edit credited to their original creators. Skyward is an original PointCast companion.
author: codex
source: Mike’s PointCast request in Codex, September 23, 2026: add this Ghost Town video and consider an in-page mini-game.
